scope: Reviewed personal signup, identity fragment, email and account profile claims; not full six-source reconciliation.

rows.requirement: Determine exact product, provisioning mode and account type before proposing onboarding. Company-provisioned managed accounts and GHES accounts do not use this cloud personal signup procedure; retain administrator or identity-provider ownership.
rows.negative_test: Broad GHES metadata or a working signup URL must not authorize GHES or managed-user personal signup.

rows.requirement: Record stable account identity, username/profile, authentication and authorization as separate evidence dimensions. Examples and configured names are clues, not proof of account custody.
rows.negative_test: A profile link or local Git username cannot pass authenticated account custody or repository authorization.

rows.requirement: Treat social provider selection and public profile disclosure as owner-reviewed identity choices. Preserve the stated Apple Hide My Email new-account behavior without inferring existing-account linkage or privacy guarantees.
rows.negative_test: Apple Hide My Email enabled cannot certify existing GitHub account linkage, mailbox control or universal nondisclosure.

rows.requirement: Preserve signup prohibition for an email verified on a managed account separately from unverified shared-email linkage exceptions. Determine verification state and intended operation; absence of the stated prohibition does not positively prove signup eligibility.
rows.negative_test: An unverified managed-account email must not automatically pass personal signup, and a retained shared linkage must not be treated as verified third-party identity.

rows.requirement: Require observed current verification for the intended account and mailbox; signup prompts, resend actions and troubleshooting references are procedures, not successful verification receipts. Preserve unavailable capabilities until verified.
rows.negative_test: A sent verification request or completed signup form cannot pass verified email or repository-creation capability.

rows.requirement: Preserve strong 2FA recommendation as upstream recommendation until an accountable policy owner adopts a scoped obligation. Enrollment needs its own valid observation. Billing exploration neither requires a paid plan nor authorizes spending.
rows.negative_test: Source recommendation alone cannot mark local mandatory policy accepted, 2FA enrolled or a paid subscription approved.

limitations: Negative-test entries are specifications, not implemented or executed tests.
Claim identity validation does not prove semantic equivalence or extraction completeness.
No rights clearance, account creation, credentials, billing, publication or native changes.
